taste:
Chicken Jalfrezi is a warming, spicy curry with tender marinated chicken and a rich sauce. Aromatic spices and fresh green chillies give it a lively kick, while crisp mixed peppers introduce a firmer bite. The description points to a curry for people who enjoy heat, rather than those seeking a mild main. No specific spice rating is supplied, so check with the pub if that distinction matters to you.

Served steaming hot, the curry comes with fragrant, fluffy pilau rice, soft warm naan and crisp poppadums. Those accompaniments create a useful contrast in texture, with the rice offering a gentler counterpoint to the robust sauce.
